CURRENT QUESTION:
how much more money was given out in 2024 than in 2023, in percent terms
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(SUBSTR("Disbursement Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount
    FROM shg_loan_register
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
    (y2024.total_amount - y2023.total_amount) / NULLIF(y2023.total_amount, 0) * 100 AS percent_increase
FROM
    yearly_totals y2023
    JOIN yearly_totals y2024 ON y2023.year = 2023 AND y2024.year = 2024;
```
